# CUDA 13.2 / torch 2.11+cu130 / triton 3.6.0 dep set.
# Includes official DeepEP main@a56d6156 built against NCCL 2.30.4 and
# NVSHMEM 3.5.19, plus the RTP FlashInfer 0.6.9 CUDA 13.2 wheels.
# FlashAttention 3 and nvidia_cutlass_dsl remain deferred.

# Core torch stack — wheels mirrored to OSS by us; upstream is
# https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130/.

# Triton 3.6.0 supports CUDA 13.x ptxas natively (no wrapper needed).
triton==3.6.0

# Use the CUDA 13.2 artifacts from the same RTP FlashInfer build.
# Pinned to the RTP fork build (not upstream 0.6.9): upstream copies an
# unpinned CPU scale during FMHA v2 CUDA graph capture; the fork build
# carries the fix. Regression-covered by the FMHA v2 prefill CUDA-graph
# unit test (test_trtllm_fmha_v2_prefill_sm12x) and the generation-prefill
# CUDA-graph smoke case generation_prefill_cuda_graph_sm120 (cuda13/sm12x).
flashinfer-python==0.6.9+8c4f4dcf
flashinfer-cubin==0.6.9+8c4f4dcf

# Upstream v1.1.0.post2@e7706faf, rebuilt for torch 2.11+cu130.
fast-hadamard-transform==1.1.0+e7706fa.cu132.torch2.11.cxx11abitrue
# Upstream v2.8.3.post1@a8aa52b1 with CUTLASS dc481792, rebuilt for CUDA 13.2.
flash-attn==2.8.3.post1+cu13torch2.11cxx11abitrue.r1

# Wheels built against torch 2.11+cu130.
# DeepGEMM 122e18b is CI-built with gcc-toolset-13: opt_glm5 plus SM12x GEMMs.

flash-mla==1.0.0+9241ae3

# Official DeepEP main@a56d6156 with legacy Buffer and V2 APIs.

# DSV4 mHC uses TileLang by default.  Keep the same version as cuda12_9.

# Unified rtp_kernel built from cuda_extension feat/port-nvfp4-xqa@94fd20eb
# against torch 2.11+cu130; NVFP4 mm only (no XQA wrappers).
